national_news.title: Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Nationwide Cleanliness Drive Conducted
bullets: The nationwide 'Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath' cleanliness drive was conducted as part of the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Campaign (Sept 17 to Oct 17).
The theme for this year's campaign is 'Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat', highlighting public participation in national sanitation goals.
Union Ministers across departments participated in Shramdaan activities, focusing on river cleanliness, sanitation in educational institutions, and airport hygiene.

national_news.title: PM Addresses Centenary Celebrations of Union Public Service Commission
bullets: PM Narendra Modi addressed the centenary celebrations of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), which completed 100 years since its establishment in 1926.
Released a UPSC Centenary Commemorative Coin, a Commemorative Stamp, and the book '100 Landmark Judgements – Shaping the Policies of UPSC and Public Service Commissions in India'.
Highlighted recent technological reforms adopted by UPSC, including AI-based duplicate application detection, OCR document evaluation, and face authentication at examination centers.

national_news.title: Govt Limits Sugar Stock Holding Period to 15 Days to Curb Hoarding
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs cut the sugar stock holding period for dealers to 15 days and capped limits at 1,000 quintals until November to check festive hoarding.
Special stock limits of 2,000 quintals were fixed for Kolkata and Assam considering regional supply chain dynamics and logistical constraints in the North-East.
The decision follows a 15% reduction in average retail sugar prices and a 28% drop in ex-mill prices from August peak levels.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Launches Financial IT Platforms on Defence Accounts Day
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh advocated for unified financial management systems across the Armed Forces and the Defence Accounts Department (DAD).

Launched key IT platforms including the SAKSHAM integration with Indian Army Financial Information System, a revamped National Compilation System, and PRISM (Payment Routing and Integrated System Management).
Announced that expenditure booking achieved approximately 100% completion in the Ministry of Defence during the last financial year.

national_news.title: Appointments Committee of the Cabinet approves re-employment of Dhirendra Ojha as PIB Principal DG
bullets: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved the re-employment of senior Indian Information Service (IIS) officer Dhirendra Ojha as Principal Director General of the Press Information Bureau (PIB).
The extension is on a contract basis for a period of one year effective from October 1, 2026, up to September 30, 2027.
The ACC also approved the temporary upgradation of a DG-level post to Principal DG level for senior officer Pragya Paliwal Gaur.

national_news.title: KVIC Chairman Highlights Role of Lijjat Papad in 'Vocal for Local' Vision
bullets: KVIC Chairman Manoj Goyal addressed women artisans of Shri Mahila Griha Udyog Lijjat Papad in Mumbai, praising its contribution to 'Vocal for Local' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'.
Established on March 15, 1959, with 7 women and Rs. 80, Lijjat Papad was recognized as a Village Industry by KVIC in 1966 and now supports over 45,000 women across 83 branches in 16 states.

KVIC highlighted that nearly 5 lakh artisans are provided employment nationwide (80% women), with Khadi and Village Industries production reaching approximately Rs. 1.25 lakh crore and sales touching Rs. 1.87 lakh crore.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Rules Out Total Ban on Firecrackers Ahead of Diwali
bullets: A Supreme Court bench comprising Justices MM Sundresh and PB Varale ruled out a complete ban on firecrackers ahead of Diwali, favoring a balanced approach.
The court indicated it will permit specific firecrackers with designated time limits, balancing religious sentiments with air pollution concerns.
The bench granted time till October 15 to the Additional Solicitor General to place on record the Central Pollution Control Board’s report on barium-based firecrackers.

national_news.title: Indian Pilot Captain Smit Machchhar Hailed for Foiling Hijack Attempt
bullets: Indian Captain Smit Machchhar was hailed globally after subduing an attacking Omani co-pilot who attempted to crash a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
Despite serious injuries, Captain Machchhar fought back, allowing passengers and crew to secure the cockpit and land safely at Tabuk Regional Airport, Saudi Arabia.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other global leaders praised the captain's extraordinary bravery and unwavering resolve in saving 174 lives.

national_news.title: CCEA Approves Rabi MSP Hike for 2027-28, PM-DHARA Scheme, and Delhi ITMS Project
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved an increase in Minimum Support Prices (MSPs) for all mandated Rabi crops for Marketing Season 2027-28, with safflower seeing the highest absolute increase of ₹675 per quintal.

The Cabinet approved the PM-DHARA (PM-Developing Harmonized and Accelerated Renewable-energy Access) Scheme to strengthen intra-state transmission for evacuating up to 135 GW of renewable energy and deploying 50 GWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
The CCEA sanctioned ₹1,789 crore for Delhi Police to implement the Intelligent Traffic Management System (ITMS) project across 42 identified corridors over 24 months.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Draft Green Hydrogen Policy 2026
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved the draft Green Hydrogen Policy 2026, aligned with the Centre's National Green Hydrogen Mission, targeting 1 lakh tonnes of annual production by 2031.
The policy aims to attract investments of around Rs 16,000 crore, generate 12,000 jobs, and establish 1 GW of electrolyser manufacturing capacity.
The Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA) has been designated as the nodal agency for implementation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Seeks IAF Assistance for Flood Relief Operations
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary sought Indian Air Force (IAF) assistance for relief and rescue operations amid severe flooding across several districts in Bihar.
Major rivers including the Ganga, Gandak, Bagmati, and Kosi have breached embankments or crossed danger marks, affecting districts like Saran, Gopalganj, and Darbhanga.
The state administration declared the following 48 hours extremely crucial for managing the rising water levels.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Launch Sankalp Portal for Digital Monitoring
bullets: The Bihar government is developing the Sankalp Portal as a unified digital platform to monitor government programmes, Cabinet decisions, and development projects.
The portal features 10 windows covering the 100-day report card, Bihar Gati projects, Chief Minister announcements, and infrastructure projects worth over ₹30 crore.
The digital initiative aims to reduce dependence on hard-copy records and streamline compliance tracking.

bihar_news.title: Severe Flood Crisis Deepens in Bihar as Gandak River Breaches Embankments
bullets: Heavy rainfall in Nepal's Gandak basin triggered severe flooding across six districts in Bihar, affecting approximately 2.03 lakh people, with West Champaran, Saran, Gopalganj, and Muzaffarpur being the worst hit.

The Water Resources Department recorded a discharge of 5.435 lakh cusecs at the Valmikinagar Gandak Barrage, causing multiple embankment breaches including at Maker block in Saran and Baikunthpur in Gopalganj.
The Gandak water level reached a record 91.25 metres at the Bagaha gauge, surpassing the previous high of 90.90 metres recorded in 2024, disrupting road connectivity and displacing residents.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Upholds Sales Tax Exemption for Industrial Units under Bihar Industrial Policy 1993
bullets: The Supreme Court dismissed appeals by the State of Bihar, upholding the High Court ruling on sales tax exemptions.
The dispute centered on Clause 10.4(i)(b) of the Industrial Policy of 1993, which granted tax exemptions for old industrial units with investments under Rs. 15 crores.
The Court ruled that executive notifications under Section 7 of the Bihar Finance Act cannot impose conditions that contradict benefits promised under the Industrial Policy.

bihar_news.title: SECI Issues Tender for 60 MW Solar Project in Gaya, Bihar
bullets: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has issued an EPC tender to develop a 60 MW inter-state transmission system (ISTS)-connected solar project in Gaya, Bihar.
The project will be located at Habibpur, Dariaura, and adjacent to the Dobhi-Patna Road, with power evacuation through a 132 kV bay at the PGCIL substation in Chandauti.
The solar power plant is designed for a lifespan of 25 years, with a comprehensive operation and maintenance (O&M) period of five years.
